Which statement about an aqueous solution of ethanoic acid is correct?
A
It reacts with magnesium to form water as one of the products.
B
It reacts with sodium carbonate to form carbon dioxide.
C
It reacts with sodium hydroxide to form hydrogen.
D
It turns red litmus paper blue.
